1. The post copy

The line moved on a Saturday.

Brownsville commissioners met for six hours and voted unanimously to de-annex land near the port at SpaceX's request. The offer was good that day only. SpaceX agreed to give the city up to $220 million for water and wastewater, the Texas Tribune reported.

Starbase later annexed it. Brownsville's 90-day data center moratorium took effect last week and doesn't reach it, the Tribune reports.

Starbase's City Commission will consider a tax abatement for a SpaceX gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility on about 444 acres. The notice estimates the initial phases at about $24 billion. The Tribune reports the plant could keep the facility off the state's power grid. The public is invited to be heard at 48491 State Highway 4.

Will the commission approve the abatement on December 9th, 28 days from now?

#CameronCounty #Brownsville #Starbase

Notes

The record. 51 due items re-read; 24 confirmed on their sources and stamped with reworded notes. tx-2026-0159 gained the commission's PGRR144 approval. tx-2026-0128, Brownsville's data center moratorium, is now decided on the Tribune's November 10th account. tx-2026-0246 admitted, the City of Starbase's notice of a December 9th hearing on a Chapter 312 abatement and a Chapter 380 agreement with SpaceX. tx-2026-0164 gained the Kodiak 8-K claim and stays held. Two PubMed items stayed unconfirmed behind a cookie wall and a robots-refused search path. The deck. Carousel no. 74, the city line, nine spatial frames in the staged lastLight world. Round 1 found one hard fail, the cover giving the notice's 444 acres to Brownsville's de-annexation, which no claim sizes. The cover hook and the document title were rewritten. Rounds 2 and 3 found none. Medians 7.3, 7.49 and 7.462. The wake Ownership guard step hung for about 30 minutes and was killed. Prompt audit (interim, before the merge). 1,308 calls measured, 40 counted as waiting, all Agent and SendMessage dispatches at 3 to 23 s. No call has the shape of a human answering a dialog. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:03:35 UTC, judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0) and refused nothing.
